source: Recorded from Claude Code (SDK 0.2.168) transcripts of real CronCreate, CronDelete, CronList and ScheduleWakeup calls. Ids and prompts are shortened; field names, result text and the structured tool_use_result shapes are as the CLI wrote them. `now` is a fixed epoch second the tests use as the call time.
